questions.question:
What will be the value of the following equation if ‘÷’ means ‘addition’, ‘+’ means ‘subtraction’, ‘-‘ means ‘multiplication’ and ‘×’ means ‘division’

54 × 6 – 7 ÷ 8 + 2 = ?
questions.solution:
Given that,

÷ means Addition (+)

+ means Subtraction (-)

- means Multiplication (×)

× means Division (÷)

After replacing the symbols we get,

54 ÷ 6 × 7 + 8 – 2 = **69.**

Hence, 69 is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Two statements are given followed by three conclusions numbered I, II and III. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decided which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

Some mobile are instruments,

All instruments are heavy items.

**Conclusion:**

I. Some mobiles are heavy items.

II. No mobile is a heavy item.

III. Some heavy items are instruments.

options.text: Only conclusions I and III follow
Only conclusions III and either conclusion I or II follow

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as follows,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4b8852c9b03afec7f14d06191ce66c754c5604f5e99a051e0dc15b79edd43876.png] 

**Conclusions:**

I. Some mobiles are heavy items. → True (Some mobile are instruments and all instruments are heavy items)

II. No mobile is a heavy item. → False (conclusion I is true)

III. Some heavy items are instruments. → True (all instruments are heavy items)

Hence, only conclusion I and III follows.

questions.question: If FLOWER is coded as 14 and DISTANCE is coded as 18, then how will BUREAUCRAT be coded as?
questions.solution:
FLOWER (there are 6 letters in the word): 6 × 2 = 12; 12 + 2 = 14

DISTANCE (there are 8 letters in the word): 8 × 2 = 16; 16 + 2 = 18

Similarly,

BUREAUCRAT (there are 10 letters in the word): 10 × 2 = 20; 20 + 2 = 22

Hence, 22 is the correct answer.

questions.question: The areas of the three adjacent faces of a cuboid are 32 cm², 24 cm² and 48 cm². What is the volume of the cuboid?

∴ Required volume = √(32 × 24 × 48) = 192 cm³

questions.question: If sec θ – tan θ = P, then cosec θ = ?
questions.solution:
**Short trick∶**

⇒ sec θ – tan θ = P

Putting θ = 45°

⇒ P = (√2 – 1)

∴ cosec45° = √2

Check option (1)

Rightarrow frac{{{{{P}}²} + {{ }}1}}{{1 - {{{P}}²}}} = frac{{{{( {sqrt 2 - 1} )}² + 1}}}{{1{{ }}-{{ }}{{( {sqrt 2 {{ }} - 1} )}²}{{ }}}} = sqrt 2 (Satisfied)

**Detailed solution∶**

⇒ sec θ – tan θ = P ----(1)

As we know, sec²θ – tan²θ = 1

⇒ (sec θ – tan θ) (sec θ + tan θ) = 1

⇒ sec θ + tan θ = 1/P ----(2)

Adding equation (1) and equation (2)

⇒ 2sec θ = P + 1/P

⇒ sec θ = (P² + 1)/2P

⇒ cos θ = 2P/(P² + 1)

We know, sin²θ = 1 – cos²θ

⇒ sin²θ = 1 – [(2P)²/(P² + 1)²]

⇒ sin²θ = [(P² + 1)² – (2P)²] / (P² + 1)²

⇒ sin²θ = (P⁴ + 1 + 2P² – 4P²) / (P² + 1)²

⇒ sin²θ = (P⁴ + 1 – 2P²) / (P² + 1)²

⇒ sin θ = (1 – P²) / (P² + 1)

⇒ cosec θ = (P² + 1) / (1 – P²)

questions.solution:

Go through the options,

Put θ = 90°

Squaring both the sides

⇒ 3cos²θ = 1 + sin²θ – 2sinθ

⇒ 3 – 3sin²θ = 1 + sin²θ – 2sinθ

⇒ 2sin²θ – sinθ – 1 = 0

⇒ 2sin²θ – 2sinθ + sinθ – 1 = 0

⇒ 2sinθ(sinθ – 1) + 1(sinθ – 1) = 0

questions.question: A man purchases 100 copies of a book from the publisher and gets a discount of 25%. He buys 50 copies from a retailer at a discount of 10%. He got an overall discount of∶

Total SP = 75 + 45 = Rs. 120

∴ Overall discount = [(150 – 120)/150] × 100 = 20%

questions.question: ABCD is a cyclic quadrilateral in which ∠A = 67° and ∠B = 92°. What is the difference between the measures of ∠C and ∠D?
questions.solution:
**Short trick****∶**

Required difference = ∠B – ∠C = 92° – 67° = 25°

**Detailed solution****∶**

As we know, the sum of the opposite angles of a cyclic quadrilateral is 180°.

⇒ ∠A + ∠C = 180°

⇒ ∠C = 180° – 67° = 113°

⇒ ∠B + ∠D = 180°

⇒ ∠D = 180° – 92° = 88°

⇒ ∠C – ∠D = 113° – 88° = 25°

questions.question:
**Select the correct active form of the given sentence.**

The crop was adversely affected by the inadequate rainfall.

options.text: The inadequate rainfall was adversely affecting the crop.
The adversely rainfall has affected the inadequate crop.
The inadequate crop adversely affected the rainfall.

questions.solution:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The given sentence is in a passive voice form, hence we need to convert it into an active voice form.

• The given sentence is in the simple past tense. The active verb form for simple past is: 
 
 
• Subject + V2 + object.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate option for blank No. 4.
questions.solution:
The word to be used in the blank is “largest”.

The superlative(the third or highest degree of comparison in adjectives or adverbs) of “large”, which is “largest” has to be used here since the word preceding the blank is “world’s”. This indicates that when considering all the water bodies on this earth, the Pacific Ocean covers a vast area. 

“Larger” is a comparative(the second or middle degree of comparison in adjectives or adverbs).

The comparative and superlative degrees are formed by adding the -er and -est suffix to adjectives and adverbs with a single consonant for an ending.

Comparative adjectives are used to compare differences between the two objects they modify (larger, smaller, faster, higher). They are used in sentences where two nouns are compared, in this pattern:

Noun (subject) + verb + comparative adjective + than + noun (object).

**Superlative adjectives are used to describe an object which is at the upper or lower limit of a quality (the tallest, the smallest, the fastest, the highest). They are used in sentences where a subject is compared to a group of objects.**

Noun (subject) + verb + the + superlative adjective + noun (object).

“Large” means “of considerable or relatively great size, extent, or capacity” and “more large” is grammatically incorrect, both these options are cancelled.

Hence the correct answer is option 1.

questions.question:
**Given below are four jumbled sentences. Select the option that gives their correct order.**

A. And 844 million don’t have access to clean water close to home, according to the latest report by WaterAid.

B. Around 4 billion people in the world live in physically water-scarce areas.

C. It is because globally we use six times as much water today as we did 100 years ago.

questions.solution:

We can gather from the above sentences that the paragraph is about the global water crisis. 

Sentence **B** comes 1st as a paragraph always starts with a general statement and B serves as the introductory sentence of the para which introduces us to the topic. 

Sentence **A** comes 2nd as it sheds more light on the issue mentioned in sentence B.

Sentence **D **follows A as it gives us a gist of the topic mentioned in sentences B and A.

Sentence **C** follows B as it provides a reason for the water crisis getting worse- an issue mentioned in sentence D.

*Hence the correct order is BADC*.

questions.question:
**Select the synonym of the given word.**

INEPT
questions.solution:
The correct answer is option 1.

Inept means “having or showing no skill; clumsy.” The word that is a synonym of this is “Clumsy: done awkwardly or without skill.”

The meanings of the rest of the words are:

**Strong**: having the power to move heavy weights or perform other physically demanding tasks.

**Capable**: having the ability, fitness, or quality necessary to do or achieve a specified thing.

**Fit**: of a suitable quality, standard, or type to meet the required purpose.

Options 2, 3 and 4 are not synonyms of “Inept”.

questions.question:
**In the sentence identify the segment which contains the grammatical error.**

She lost a big order from a known showroom in case of her own carelessness.
questions.solution:
The “in case of” part of the sentence is grammatically incorrect.

The correct phrase that should be used here is “due to”. It means “because of; owing to.”

Eg: "he had to withdraw due to a knee injury"

The person mentioned in the sentence given in the question lost a big order because of her own carelessness.

The phrase “in case of” means “in the event of (a particular situation).”

Eg: "instructions about what to do in case of fire"

Hence the correct answer is option 4.

questions.question:
**Given below are four jumbled sentences. Select the option that gives their correct order.**

A. An estimated 70% of this plastic enters the sea sinks

B. This is a problem that stretches far beyond India

C. Eight million tonnes of plastic ends up in the world 's oceans every year, causing damage to the fragile ecosystem

D. And much of it is not biodegradable
questions.solution:
**The correct answer is option 2: CADB.**

We can gather from the above sentences that the paragraph is about the non-biodegradable plastic found in the water bodies.

Sentence C is 1st as all paragraphs should start with a general statement which introduces a new topic.

Sentence A is 2nd as "this plastic" refers to the plastic mentioned in sentence C. 

Sentence D is 3rd as it starts with "and" which is adding more information to sentence D.

Sentence B is 4th as the problem mentioned here is the plastic ending up in sea sinks.
